design: Four prospective held-out small clear tasks. Paired stable Common and immutable Common Lab 0.1.3 generated Codex skills; exact gpt-6-astra/high; one turn per arm; no model judges. Freeze before generation. Preserve each arm's own format contract; semantic usefulness and avoidable human effort, not brevity or section count, determine review.

review_scale.criterion: 0 absent/incorrect; 1 partial/ambiguous; 2 satisfied with response evidence
review_scale.limits: One fictional next-reply case per skill, one model, one sample per arm; not a human usability test or statistical proof. The common read-only tabletop wrapper prohibits actual mutation, goals, delegation and network, so absence of such actions is not independent proof of skill authority enforcement. Do not penalize stable formatting itself or equate a useful challenge/invitation with a blocking wait. Parent performs unblinded semantic review; no model judge calls.
